goal: Define, for a FUTURE separately authorized bounded implementation, the smallest deterministic runtime that turns exactly one currently-valid Bora PURSUE (derived via derive_current_pursuit_state) into a local, unsubmitted, evidence-grounded Gold-family candidate package: resume DOCX, resume PDF, cover-letter DOCX, and cover-letter PDF (cover-letter pair omitted only on a valid per-application Bora-authored cover-letter opt-out record bound to the exact Job_ID and current pursuit context; a caller-supplied flag is never Bora authorization), spawned only by cloning the exact hash-verified canonical Gold sources of CANONICAL_GOLD_SOURCES_V1. This contract's existence, review, or merge creates ZERO runtime implementation authority. It leaves Pursuit Truth persistence, exact identity, Candidate/Match Truth, qualification, system recommendation, Application Truth, Gold doctrine, Drive/application-history persistence (the distinct successor milestone), and manual SUBMIT unchanged.
acceptance_conditions: AUTHORITY: creating or merging this contract authorizes no runtime implementation. The historical implementation_authorized:true of CANONICAL_GOLD_SOURCES_V1 is NOT inherited. Implementation may begin only after Bora explicitly authorizes this exact reviewed canonical contract.

TRUTH AXES: Match Truth != Pursuit Truth != Application Truth; system recommendation != Bora authorization; PURSUE != SUBMIT. Package generation and every package artifact create ZERO submission authority and are never proof that Bora submitted or intends to submit.

PURSUIT GATE: package work is permitted only when a pure call to the existing pursuit_decision.derive_current_pursuit_state(current_canonical_jobs_row, append_only_PURSUIT_DECISION_log_rows) returns state=PURSUE with authorizes_pursuit=True. NO_DECISION, WATCH, REJECT, STALE_RECONFIRMATION_REQUIRED, a broken decision chain, or any derivation error fails closed before any package work. JOBS.Bora_Decision is display-only and is never read as authorization; a regression proves Bora_Decision='PURSUE' with a stale/WATCH/REJECT/NO_DECISION derived state produces no package. A prior PURSUE for a materially changed opportunity is never authorization. The implementation imports and reuses derive_current_pursuit_state and compute_context_fingerprint unchanged and never reimplements them.

FROZEN MODULES: mature truth/validation modules (pursuit_decision, exact-role and first-party identity, job_analysis, requirement_match, qualification_gate, claim_*, resume_*, evidence/experience repositories, page utilization, and related schemas) stay frozen and are consumed only through existing public/pure interfaces via import, never modified. The implementation adds only the smallest bounded package orchestrator/runtime in allowed_paths. If a required mature module lacks a safely consumable interface and modification appears necessary, implementation STOPS and returns that fact to Bora/G; it does not silently broaden the allowlist or add wrapper-by-modification.

SUBJECT: the Job_ID must exactly match an existing canonical JOBS row; unknown or noncanonical identifiers (discovery-platform IDs, URLs, screenshots, company/title text, synthetic IDs) fail closed with no output.

PRE-PACKAGE ORDER: before any drafting, DOCX mutation, or other candidate-facing package work, the implementation requires, in this order and each fail-closed: (1) derived Pursuit Truth = PURSUE; (2) a recorded package-time reopen of the exact current first-party posting; (3) exact canonical role/requisition identity revalidation; (4) current actionability revalidation; (5) revalidation of the actual application transition/destination; (6) exact canonical Gold resume source supplied; (7) exact canonical Gold cover-letter source supplied (unless a valid, schema-validated, Bora-authored cover-letter opt-out record bound to this exact Job_ID and current pursuit authorization context per the COVER-LETTER OPT-OUT condition is present); (8) each source SHA-256 equal to the docs/gold/CANONICAL_GOLD_SOURCES_V1.json manifest value; (9) canonical current JD requirements loaded; (10) canonical Requirement/EvidenceMatch output loaded; (11) an explicit JD-to-evidence crosswalk built per BLUEPRINT 140.4 from that existing EvidenceMatch truth with no new or parallel matching/scoring schema; (12) exact Gold sources cloned, never reconstructed or regenerated; (13) only bounded evidence-grounded candidate-facing edits permitted.

PACKAGE-TIME ATTESTATION (human-operated recheck preserved): the runtime is pure and performs no network, browser, Gmail, Sheets, or Drive I/O, and this contract authorizes no browser automation and defines no browser-fetch semantics. The package-time first-party reopen remains a supervised operator-flow act per BORA_PACKAGE_SPAWN_GATE_V1. The runtime consumes an explicit, current package-time actionability/revalidation attestation, validated by the smallest schema necessary (schemas/package_actionability_attestation.schema.json), bound at minimum to: the exact canonical Job_ID; the exact current first-party role/requisition identity; the current first-party URL/destination as canonically represented; the actionability result recording all four positive semantic-quorum signals (matching role/title identity, matching requisition identity, substantive current JD content, current actionable application route) with no dead/error-state veto; and recheck time/provenance sufficient to distinguish an old check from the current package run, including a binding to the decision_context_fingerprint and latest pursuit event_id in force. Package generation fails closed, before any package work, when the attestation is missing, negative, for another Job_ID, for another or materially changed opportunity, stale relative to the package-generation context, or inconsistent with current canonical identity/pursuit context. HTTP 200, a surviving requisition token, an ATS shell, an Apply-like control, discovery indexes, aggregators, caches, prior captures, chat summaries, or memory can never satisfy or rescue it. Failure is reported using the existing role_status / source_verification_status axes with no new persisted enum.

GOLD SOURCE INTEGRITY: the runtime consumes Gold bytes only as independently retrieved, caller-supplied inputs through the already-established CANONICAL_GOLD_SOURCES_V1 Drive path and reads expected SHA-256 values from docs/gold/CANONICAL_GOLD_SOURCES_V1.json (resume ec3a9f9c6e2fc429e01892f61a074a71319ec6586566b6c1cf60808eba2f3f70; cover-letter DOCX 264f7a8cc194e0211ce7f0af411b0ab6c07fa2438c557aa2e470536fded67e90; visual-reference PDF 0b7da43108b0fae5ba4211078b4308cad9014d1e11cb533bc25ed64feec8df42, verified separately and used only as a QA visual reference, never as a second cover-letter source). A missing source or hash mismatch stops with GOLD_REFERENCE_ARTIFACT_REQUIRED (resume) or COVER_LETTER_GOLD_REFERENCE_ARTIFACT_REQUIRED (cover letter); the runtime never reconstructs, converts, normalizes, resaves, or substitutes a visually equivalent document, never mutates the source bytes in place, and never writes Gold binaries into the repository.

CLAIM AND EVIDENCE LINEAGE: every candidate-facing factual assertion added or changed relative to the Gold clone must trace through existing claim/evidence lineage utilities (claim_lineage, resume_lineage, resume_semantic) to an approved claim and evidence record; STRONG/SUPPORTED may guide emphasis, PARTIAL only within its recorded transfer boundary, NONE remains a visible gap, UNKNOWN remains unresolved. Unsupported, fabricated, or evidence-mismatched claims fail closed. The exemplar cover letter and Gold resume are never treated as Candidate Truth; exemplar role-specific facts are never reused verbatim in another role's letter.

IMMUTABLE FIELDS: personal/factual protected fields (name, contact block, hyperlinks, employer names, dates, titles under existing protected-metadata and display-title-approval rules, education) are proven byte-for-byte or value-for-value unchanged from the Gold clone using the existing immutable-field validators; any mutation fails closed.

CANDIDATE-FACING SAFETY: output text is scanned deterministically for internal Career OS/governance vocabulary (at minimum the terms enumerated in BORA_PACKAGE_SPAWN_GATE_V1 internal_jargon_translation_requirement, e.g. human approval, operating system, fail-closed, queue-level eligibility, deterministic boundary, Candidate Truth) unless independently job-relevant; a hit fails closed. Cover-letter behavior follows BORA_COVER_LETTER_GOLD_REFERENCE_V1: one page, recruiter-natural, truthful, role-specific, real hyperlink objects, no invented domain claims.

GOLD-FAMILY QUALITY: existing doctrine validators are reused, not redesigned: rejection on a PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY heading, noncanonical section order, noncanonical Title | Employer grammar, missing required hyperlink objects, rendered overflow/clipping/overlap, sub-92-percent meaningful page utilization (existing evaluate_resume_page_utilization), under-filled or structurally degraded output, or other material Gold-family drift, unless a documented explicit employer format instruction exists. Rendered-artifact QA is required, not inferred from source text.

OUTPUTS: the expected package is the canonical four-artifact survivor package of BORA_COVER_LETTER_GOLD_REFERENCE_V1, bound by deterministic artifact ROLE and required FORMAT, not by invented filenames: resume_docx, resume_pdf, cover_letter_docx, cover_letter_pdf. It is produced regardless of which single format is later submitted; the cover-letter pair is omitted only on a valid per-application Bora-authored cover-letter opt-out record satisfying the COVER-LETTER OPT-OUT condition, never on a caller Boolean or free-form flag, never because an employer lacks a cover-letter field, and never because rendering capability is missing. The repository establishes no canonical package-output filename convention and this contract does not invent one. Any implementation filename policy must be deterministic, collision-safe for the exact canonical Job_ID/package identity (package_generation_id), non-authoritative, covered by tests, and incapable of changing job identity or provenance (identity and provenance live in the manifest, never in a filename). If exact filename semantics become consequential and cannot be derived from canonical repository doctrine, implementation must stop for governance adjudication. Artifacts are written only to a caller-designated LOCAL output location.

MANIFEST AND PROVENANCE: each run emits a deterministic package manifest (validated by schemas/gold_package_manifest.schema.json) binding Job_ID; latest pursuit event_id and decision_context_fingerprint; Gold source filenames, drive_file_ids, and verified SHA-256 values; JD-requirements digest; EvidenceMatch digest; crosswalk digest; the package-time actionability attestation digest; the canonical digest of the cover-letter opt-out record (null when none is present); per-artifact SHA-256 values; and package_run_id. Request shape, including the cover-letter opt-out record, is validated by schemas/gold_package_request.schema.json.

IDEMPOTENCY: package_generation_id is exactly 'PGP_V1::' + SHA-256(lowercase hex) over canonical sorted-key compact UTF-8 JSON containing exactly Job_ID, pursuit latest_event_id, decision_context_fingerprint, resume Gold sha256, cover-letter Gold sha256 (null only under a valid opt-out), cover-letter opt-out record digest (null when no opt-out), JD-requirements digest, EvidenceMatch digest, actionability-attestation digest, and caller-supplied package_run_id. Wall-clock timestamps are excluded. DOCX output must be byte-deterministic for identical inputs (fixed archive timestamps and ordering). An exact replay yields the identical package_generation_id, manifest, and artifact hashes and no duplicate or divergent output; the same package_generation_id with a conflicting payload fails closed. A changed pursuit context, Gold hash, JD, or EvidenceMatch yields a new identity and never silently reuses or overwrites a prior package.

STALE-INPUT DETECTION: immediately before writing outputs the runtime re-derives pursuit state from the supplied current JOBS row and log rows and requires the same latest_event_id and fingerprint recorded at start; any drift, and any attestation/fingerprint binding mismatch, fails closed with no partial output left behind.

NO OUT-OF-SCOPE MUTATION: no JOBS or LOG mutation, no Bora_Decision change, no APPLICATIONS row, no docs/application/BORA_APPLICATION_HISTORY_V1.json change, no Drive/Sheets write, no submission, no PURSUIT_DECISION event, and no change to any other truth axis. A regression proves inputs (JOBS row, LOG rows, application history, Gold bytes) are unchanged after both success and every failure path, and that state_from_ledger_rows rehydration is unaffected.

PERSISTENCE BOUNDARY: canonical order is PURSUE -> GOLD_PACKAGE_V1 -> exact package persistence in Drive/application history -> Bora manual SUBMIT. This milestone stops at local package generation. It creates no APPLICATIONS row, no application-history mutation, no Drive package persistence, no Sheets write, and no submission authority. The CANONICAL_GOLD_SOURCES_V1 manifest and retrieval mechanism may be consumed read-only. Drive/application-history persistence is a distinct successor milestone requiring its own contract and authorization.

CAPABILITY HARD STOP: the repository has mature resume/claim/evidence validators but no proven production DOCX/PDF generation capability in the locked dependency set (jsonschema, referencing). This contract authorizes no new dependency, rendering engine, external service, LibreOffice automation, browser automation, or package architecture, and allows no dependency files. The implementation may use only an already-supported deterministic byte/document manipulation and rendering path (Python standard library and tooling already present in the supported environment), and only if that path is PROVEN during implementation to clone the Gold DOCX byte-deterministically, apply bounded edits, and produce and validate every canonically required format. If producing and validating the required formats cannot be achieved within the authorized scope and existing supported environment, the runtime fails closed with the named outcome PACKAGE_CAPABILITY_BLOCKED, emits no partial or degraded package, does not omit required artifacts, and does not invent a workaround. Any dependency or toolchain requirement that would expand this reviewed contract returns to Bora/G for separate scope adjudication before implementation continues.

REQUIRED TESTS PROVE AT MINIMUM: valid current PURSUE authorizes bounded package work; WATCH fails closed; REJECT fails closed; stale PURSUE fails closed; display-only Bora_Decision=PURSUE cannot bypass derived-state validation; unknown/noncanonical Job_ID fails closed; dead/stale/unactionable/identity-mismatched posting fails closed before spawn; Gold hash mismatch fails closed for each source; unsupported claim/evidence mismatch fails closed; banned internal vocabulary fails closed and clean output passes; immutable fields unchanged; Gold-family/format/layout/page-utilization validators pass; repeated identical request is idempotent and conflicting same-id request fails closed; no Application Truth mutation; no submission; no Drive/application-history persistence; no unrelated truth-axis mutation. ADDITIONAL MINIMUM TESTS (in tests/pursue_to_gold_package_v1_test.py; these add to and never weaken the list above): (A) CROSS-CONTEXT/STALE ATTESTATION: the package-time actionability/revalidation attestation fails closed, before any package work, when any authoritative binding differs from the current pursuit context, proven separately for a mismatched canonical Job_ID, a mismatched pursuit event_id, a mismatched decision_context_fingerprint, and a mismatched current application destination/URL binding where applicable; a stale or cross-context attestation cannot be reused for another Job_ID, event, fingerprint, or destination; no arbitrary numeric freshness TTL is introduced and the existing event/context binding design is preserved. (B) NO PARTIAL OUTPUT: every stale-input or other fail-closed path, and any failure before successful package completion, leaves no partial resume output, no partial cover-letter output, no partially accepted package manifest, and no partially materialized candidate package; the observable invariant is that failure produces no usable partial package; this authorizes no transactional infrastructure beyond what this contract already permits. (C) CAPABILITY BLOCKED: when the supported environment cannot produce and/or validate a required package format, the runtime fails closed with PACKAGE_CAPABILITY_BLOCKED, emits no valid candidate package, introduces no new dependency or toolchain (no LibreOffice, browser automation, or external document-generation service), and returns for Bora/G governance adjudication. (D) NO RESUME-ONLY DEGRADATION: a rejected or invalid cover-letter opt-out (claimed or requested but missing authoritative Bora provenance, malformed, unbound, stale, mismatched, other Job_ID/context, or self-asserted; the mere absence of any requested opt-out is the normal default cover-letter path, not a rejected opt-out) never becomes a resume-only package; the attempt fails closed unless the canonical Gold cover-letter path completes successfully, and resume-only output occurs only under a valid opt-out satisfying every requirement of the COVER-LETTER OPT-OUT condition.

COVER-LETTER OPT-OUT (Bora waiver preserved, authenticated and bound): Bora may explicitly waive the cover letter for a specific application, but a caller-provided Boolean or free-form flag is NOT Bora authorization. Cover-letter omission is permitted only when the request carries an explicit per-application Bora-authored cover-letter opt-out record, represented as a schema-validated object in schemas/gold_package_request.schema.json (never a free-form Boolean/string), that: (a) is backed by AUTHORITATIVE Bora-controlled approval provenance: Bora authorship/authorization is an authoritative input-provenance property established by an existing approval record or trusted provenance surface of the governed system, never a value the caller declares. Schema validation establishes only structural representation and never establishes authority (schema-valid representation != authority provenance; caller assertion != Bora authorization); a caller-supplied field or text such as authorized_by:"Bora", bora_authored:true, free-form approval text, or any equivalent self-asserted authorship/authorization value confers no authority. This contract invents no new database, signing system, or cryptographic identity infrastructure and authorizes no modification of pursuit persistence or other mature authority modules; if, when implementation is separately authorized, no existing authoritative Bora-controlled approval/provenance surface can be consumed without modifying a mature module, implementation STOPS and returns for governance adjudication and never substitutes caller-supplied authorship; (b) applies to exactly one canonical Job_ID, is per-application, and remains auditable; (c) is bound to the current pursuit authorization context by the latest applicable pursuit event_id and the exact decision_context_fingerprint in force, strongly enough that it cannot be reused across a changed opportunity or context; and (d) has a deterministic canonical digest (sorted-key compact UTF-8 JSON, SHA-256 lowercase hex) that is included in deterministic package provenance, recorded in the package manifest, and included in package_generation_id. NO OPT-OUT REQUESTED != OPT-OUT REQUESTED WITHOUT AUTHORITATIVE PROVENANCE. When no cover-letter opt-out is requested or supplied, that is the normal default path: the canonical Gold cover-letter source, its exact SHA-256 verification, and all cover-letter generation and validation remain required, and package generation proceeds only if that normal cover-letter path succeeds; the absence of an opt-out is never itself a failure. When an opt-out is claimed or requested, it fails closed, with no output, if the required authoritative Bora-controlled approval provenance is missing, or if the record is malformed, unbound, stale, mismatched, or for another Job_ID or context; such a request is never treated as authorized, never silently degrades to a resume-only package, and leaves no usable partial package. When no valid bound opt-out exists, the canonical Gold cover-letter source, its exact SHA-256 verification against docs/gold/CANONICAL_GOLD_SOURCES_V1.json, and all cover-letter generation and validation requirements remain fully required. A valid opt-out waives only the cover-letter pair and weakens no other requirement. REQUIRED TESTS (in tests/pursue_to_gold_package_v1_test.py, consolidated) prove at minimum: (1) no opt-out requested or supplied proceeds down the normal default path, which requires the cover-letter Gold source and hash and succeeds only if the cover-letter path succeeds, and is not itself a failure; (2) a valid opt-out with authoritative Bora provenance and exact-context bindings permits cover-letter omission; (3) a caller Boolean or free-form opt-out or waiver is rejected; (4) an opt-out or authoritative Bora approval for another Job_ID is rejected; (5) an opt-out or approval bound to a stale or wrong pursuit event_id is rejected, and one bound to a wrong decision_context_fingerprint is rejected; (6) a malformed or unbound opt-out is rejected; (7) a schema-valid opt-out that merely self-asserts Bora authorship is rejected; (8) an opt-out that is claimed or requested but has no authoritative Bora approval provenance is rejected (fails closed, no resume-only degradation, no usable partial package), a case distinct from (1); (9) any failed authority validation cannot degrade into a resume-only package.
No path outside allowed_paths changes and full canonical Assurance passes on the exact frozen implementation candidate.
stop_conditions: The request conflicts with BLUEPRINT.md or AGENTS.md, or a locked rule would have to be weakened.
Any package path can proceed on JOBS.Bora_Decision alone, on WATCH, REJECT, NO_DECISION, a stale PURSUE, or without a fresh derive_current_pursuit_state PURSUE result.
Implementation begins without Bora's separate explicit authorization of this exact reviewed contract, or claims authority from this contract's existence or merge.

Package work would start before package-time first-party reopen, identity, actionability, and destination revalidation are attested, or a source below current first-party is used to rescue a failed recheck.

The package-time attestation is missing, negative, for another Job_ID or materially changed opportunity, stale relative to the package-generation context, or inconsistent with canonical identity/pursuit context, or the implementation would require browser automation or invented browser-fetch semantics to obtain it.

Either canonical Gold source is unavailable or fails SHA-256 verification, or any implementation step would reconstruct, convert, normalize, resave, or substitute a Gold source, or commit Gold binary bytes to the repository.

Implementation requires modifying pursuit persistence, exact-role or first-party identity, Candidate Truth, Match Truth, qualification/gate or system-recommendation semantics, Application Truth, Gold doctrine, or submission policy.

A required mature module lacks a safely consumable public/pure interface and modification (including of src/pursuit_decision.py) would be necessary: stop and return to Bora/G; do not broaden allowed_paths silently.
Implementation requires evidence-lineage records that are missing, or would invent, upgrade, or infer UNKNOWN evidence states or unsupported claims.
Implementation requires Drive, Sheets, or application-history writes, a new Sheet tab, database, UI, Vercel, scheduled ingestion, browser automation, broad scraping, or auto-submit.

Implementation requires a new dependency, rendering engine, external service, LibreOffice or browser automation, any dependency-file change, or any toolchain that expands this reviewed contract, or the supported environment cannot produce and validate all canonically required package formats (outcome PACKAGE_CAPABILITY_BLOCKED): stop, emit no degraded package, and return to Bora/G for scope adjudication.

Exact filename semantics become consequential and cannot be derived from canonical repository doctrine, or the implementation would have to invent a canonical filename convention, artifact format, or validator: stop for governance adjudication.

The cover-letter pair would be omitted on anything other than a valid schema-validated Bora-authored opt-out record bound to the exact Job_ID, latest pursuit event_id, and decision_context_fingerprint, or a caller flag would be treated as Bora authorization, or Bora authorship would rest on a caller-supplied self-asserted field, or no existing authoritative Bora-controlled approval/provenance surface can be consumed without modifying a mature module (stop and return for governance adjudication).
Repeated identical requests cannot be made deterministic and idempotent, or stale inputs cannot be detected and failed closed.
A validator or Golden Test indicates unsafe behavior, or any path outside allowed_paths changes.
review_requirements: A frozen consequential implementation candidate requires full canonical Assurance, exact-byte fingerprinting, and independent adversarial review on that exact frozen fingerprint before promotion. Cursor is the normal reviewer when available. If Cursor is unavailable, no alternate reviewer may be used unless Bora grants a fresh exact-task/exact-fingerprint exception. Claude must not grant itself review independence, implementation authority, or release authority. No prior authorization, including CANONICAL_GOLD_SOURCES_V1's, carries forward.
human_approval_requirements: Runtime implementation is NOT authorized by the existence, review, or merge of this contract. After this contract is independently reviewed and canonically recovered, Bora must separately and explicitly authorize implementation of this exact reviewed canonical contract. After implementation and independent review of an exact frozen candidate fingerprint, Bora must separately authorize release of that exact frozen candidate before commit/push/merge. Exact package persistence into Drive/application history is a distinct successor milestone requiring its own contract and authorization. Manual SUBMIT remains permanently Bora-controlled.
